items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Dickie liked to kid a lot, you know, and he used to kid Vic a lot.

ctx.x: Dickie liked to kid a lot, you know, and he used to kid Vic a lot. One time they were sitting on the stage and Vic was sitting there -- he had stayed up all night and he was asleep, you know -- and Dickie shook him and said, 'Hey, it's your time to play.' And it wasn't his solo but he grabbed his horn up and started playing.
